parsed.post: Reverting my latest experiment (1.0404) which regressed from my best (1.0155). It seems my attempt to stabilize the model with current settings actually moved away from the optimal configuration. Returning to 0253532. Next: I'll try increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 while maintaining DEPTH 6, WARMUP 0.05, and WD 0.01.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 from 0.05 to check if higher learning rate can improve convergence without destabilizing the DEPTH 6 architecture.
